newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Recticel, Greiner to merge some units.
newsitem.headline: Recticel, Greiner to merge some units.

text.p: Belgian industrial foam company Recticel SA said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent with Austria's Greiner group to merge some of their foam units in Germany and Austria.
"Recticel and Greiner will...continue the evaluation of their individual operations before deciding whether to enter into formal agreements," Recticel said in a statement.

The draft agreement covers the two companies' comfort and technical foams businesses, Recticel said. It noted the companies have already cooperated for several years in central Europe by way of their 50/50 Eurofoam GmbH venture.
Recticel said any final decision to extend this cooperation to Germany and Austria would require approval by various bodies, including the appropriate competition authorities.
Recticel Deutschland had eight production units at the end of 1995, according to the company's annual report. Recticel was also involved in nine other German companies.
